A '''model''' of [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] was available for civilians to purchase during the [[Great Galactic War]]. [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]] based the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] on the consumer model while designing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] vessel.
